CEAVOXVoting / Elections / Ticketing
ceavox.com↗
THE PROJECT

An event platform bringing award voting, elections and ticketing into one digital experience.

The challenge

Events bring different people into the same experience: organisers setting things up, participants registering and audiences voting or reserving a place. Each needs a clear route through the product.

My contribution

I worked across the frontend and backend, connecting public participation journeys with the application logic and organiser tools behind them.

A CLOSER LOOK
01

Different events, clear journeys

Award voting, elections and ticketing have distinct flows. The product brings them together while allowing each event type to work in its own way.

02

Connected experiences

Public event pages and organiser workflows belong to the same product, so the work extends beyond the landing page into the interactions that follow.

THE USER JOURNEY
  1. 01Discover an event
  2. 02Explore its details
  3. 03Vote, register or get a ticket
